title: Dr. Christian
paragraphs: Jean Hersholt stars as Dr. Paul Christian, the physician of the small town of River's End, where medical cases, family conflicts, romances, and community problems become warm dramatic stories, many selected through the program's listener-written script contests.

Jean Hersholt stars as Dr. Paul Christian in River’s End. The series combines medical/community drama with listener-written storytelling. Frozen GRH coverage contains 173 dated recordings through December 23, 1953; the documented network series continued to January 6, 1954.
GRH documents the program through CBS / Vaseline network run (November 7, 1937 to January 6, 1954) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Jean Hersholt (performer on 158 recordings), Rosemary De Camp (performer on 117 recordings), Art Gilmore (announcer on 88 recordings), Bob Anderson (announcer on 34 recordings), Gloria Holden (performer on 18 recordings), Helen Claire (performer on 17 recordings), and Andre Baruch (announcer on 15 recordings).
The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include family conflict and responsibility, children, youth and parenting, romance, courtship and marriage, medical care, illness and treatment, small-town community relationships, and war, military service and veterans.

GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Listener-written network drama and the Dr. Christian Award, Small-town physician as community moral authority, and Long-form sponsor integration in network radio.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (84 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (35 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (32 shared credited people), [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (30 shared credited people), and [[show|broadway-is-my-beat|Broadway Is My Beat]] (26 shared credited people).
